targeting.source: GOB 53 selects a hostile recipient within 16 m and specifies viral TestFunction 2.
targeting.runtime: AbilityHandler checks a live hostile selection and range before starting the cast. The landing path checks sight and runs the viral contest before any damage.
targeting.test: PR612 verifies clear hits, no-target, ally, range and sight refusals. PR615 verifies a clear cast with hit=False and no damage or effects. The stock-request bootstrap checks the deflection notice and FX record; native visual FX was obscured. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/612#issuecomment-7057719757 https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/615#issuecomment-7058034188

behavior-tests.source: GOB 105 requires Rifles in interlock, uses 20 IS with 8 s own and 5 s shared reuse, and attaches ballistic base 8 and two −5 resistance modifiers for 10 s.
behavior-tests.runtime: The queued special resolves through the interlock contest and the Rifle move mapping, then applies fixed base damage plus typed mitigation and the paired timed debuffs.
behavior-tests.test: StarterGunSpecialAdmissionMode verifies interlock admission and style. StarterGunmanShotDamageTests asserts the stored base and pair; StarterBodyShotMode proves the paired add/remove, and StarterGunmanResistanceMode checks move and damage on neutral and resisted targets. Native PR616 shows a lost round followed by move 11364, both −5 records and hits of 8 and 6. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/616#issuecomment-7058153028

damage.source: GOB 126 defines a fixed ballistic health modifier of 11 and damage type 1.
damage.runtime: The landed interlock move uses the fixed catalog base when the legacy data endpoints are incomplete, then applies typed influence and the recipient's ballistic resistance.
